candidate.name: 38th & Blake RTD Park-n-Ride driveway candidate
candidate.selection_reason: Near-central Denver transit parking alternative after 10th/Osage operator record showed zero auto spaces. Does not resolve a single-anchor policy for Denver-Aurora-Centennial or supersede Union Station proposal.

reviewer.procedure: Inspect operator map metadata, linked facilities layer, zero-space Osage record and 200-space Blake record; compare generalized geometry with pinned Colorado OSM driveway; replay deterministic source screening and assess all five access questions.

sources.provenance: Operator-owned rtdgis map item. Description explicitly says generalized planning locations; full exact response and request provenance retained.
Operator-linked facilities service, Denver facilities with AUTOS > 0. Capacity is not unrestricted-use permission or exact driveway geometry.
Deterministic retained-source screening; OSM is not independent access evidence.

physical_connection.reason: OSM driveway 436487553 meets Wynkoop/39th at node 176077058. Operator geometry is explicitly generalized, so this does not independently identify or verify the entrance.

legal_motor_access.reason: RTD lists 200 auto spaces, but full parking conditions, vehicle class, hours and exact driveway rights are unresolved. Operator guidance requests returned HTTP 403; this is missing evidence, not denial of access.

same_grade.reason: OSM shared nodes and a surface-parking tag are not independent grade evidence for the selected path.

direction_and_turns.reason: OSM tags driveway two-way; current entrance signs and permitted street-to-driveway turns have not been independently established.

connector_cost.reason: The modeled driveway is 81.396 m; generalized-point displacement is 91.138 m. Neither is an adopted anchor-to-road connector cost. Actual anchor/path and speed assumption remain unset.

limitations: No adopted anchor, approved connector, ledger entry, Census-origin replacement or production-map change.
Need independently locatable driveway/site plan plus applicable motor-access conditions and current direction/turn/grade evidence before separate approval.
Generalized geometry fields and attribute LATITUDE/LONGITUDE differ; neither is accepted as an entrance.
HTTP failures are retained in the bundle; this review does not interpret unavailable guidance as permission.
